instruction: `aiagentmemory doctor` reports a server or bridge built without a version stamp as UNSTAMPED, yet the build commands in the docs build exactly that. In the fenced command blocks of README.md, INSTALL.md and TROUBLESHOOTING.md that build the server, `go build -o agentsmemory ./cmd/server` and `go build -o ~/.local/bin/aiagentmemory-server ./cmd/server`, stamp the version the way INSTALL.md's own "Stamp the version" example does: insert `-trimpath -ldflags "-s -w -X main.version=$(git describe --tags)"` right after `go build`, keeping the -o target, the package, the indentation and any trailing comment as they are. Inline mentions of the command in prose stay as they are (INSTALL.md's "Building it yourself is `go build -o agentsmemory ./cmd/server`." and README.md's "Prefer to build it yourself? ..."), and so do the commands that build the aiagentmemory client and README.md's developer `go build ./...`. Change nothing else.

require.match: #    A Docker-only install produces none \(issue #199\)\.\ngo build -trimpath -ldflags "-s -w -X main\.version=\$\(git describe --tags\)" -o ~/\.local/bin/aiagentmemory-server \./cmd/server\n
Building it yourself is `go build -o agentsmemory \./cmd/server`\.
